text: Every one of these disasters began the same way. The ground shook, and people had minutes to act.
December fifth, twenty twenty-four. Five million Californians got a tsunami warning that never said who was in the zone, or where to go.
Most people never prepare. Only thirty-one percent of American households know their evacuation route. And up to half of quake injuries in Japan come from furniture.

Yet preparation works. In twenty eleven, survivors who left at the last minute were ten times as likely to be caught by the wave. Japan estimates that if everyone evacuates within ten minutes, deaths in its next great tsunami fall by seventy percent.
So we built Safe Zone, on Meta's Sam three point one and Muse Spark. It gets a household to those benchmarks in one sitting, then talks them through the emergency.
Step one: prepare. Safe Zone checks your home against the official tsunami hazard map. This one is inside the zone.
Then, one photo per room. Sam three point one outlines everything that could tip, fall, or swing open.
Muse Spark reasons about how they relate. This wardrobe can tip onto the bed. That box sits right above it.
Then code checks the model. Muse Spark suggested a spot in a doorway, so Safe Zone set it aside. The model proposes. Code decides.
Muse Spark checks the go bag against the Ready dot gov kit, and never says it is enough.
Then the route. Every walking route is checked in code. It must end outside the hazard area, on land, and never lead deeper in. This one is ten minutes at a child's pace, saved for offline use.
In Japan it uses official maps and evacuation sites. Where it can't check a route, it says so.
In five minutes, a household has done what most people never do.
Step two: when it happens. During shaking, Safe Zone says one thing. Drop, cover, and hold on. Nothing on that screen tells you to move.
When it stops: go now, on foot. Then it talks you out, turn by turn, even with no signal, and lists shelters that fit your household.
Remember those numbers. Getting out early, and securing the room around you, save lives. Safe Zone puts that preparation in every home.
Safe Zone. Built on Meta A I. Prepare once, then follow the plan.
